claims.text: Charter 18 Aug 1988: Art 7 'The Day of Judgement will not come about until Moslems fight the Jews'; Art 13 'There is no solution for the Palestinian question except through Jihad'; Art 22 Jews 'were behind World War I'; Art 32 cites the 'Protocols of the Elders of Zion'.

2017 document: conflict 'is with the Zionist project, not with the Jews because of their religion'; accepts a state on the June 4, 1967 lines without recognizing Israel; armed resistance 'strategic choice'; distance from Muslim Brotherhood; Hroub: anti-Semitic overtones of 1988 charter never fully countered before.
Netanyahu spokesman David Keyes: Hamas 'is attempting to fool the world but it will not succeed'.
